_comment: Example ACTUAL numbers file for the `reconcile` subcommand. This is DATA you supply, not something the tool derives - read these off the Go subscription usage dashboard (or wherever the ground truth lives) for one calendar day, per model, per wallet (providerID). The `date`/`tz` keys here are used unless overridden on the command line. This particular snapshot is the reconciliation reference from the session-usage-tool card: 2026-08-29, local (UTC+3) day boundary, five opencode-go models. Copy and edit with your own numbers for other days.
